purpose: Teach: 暴言/往来/斉唱/流星/昇る/追っかけ/エコー/ライティング

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時の、本気で、絶対、政治家の、絶対、暴言、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on wartime political discourse was genuinely impressive. I was really impressed by how thoroughly you handled it.
lines.style: Warm, measured praise. Eyes bright with genuine recognition. Leans forward slightly. Steady pacing—not rushing the compliment. Voice rises gently at the end, inviting response.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。古代の、本気で、絶対、市場の、絶対、往来、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I really put a lot of care into researching ancient marketplace dynamics. I'm grateful for the opportunity to study something that deep.
lines.style: Respectful and sincere. Sits up straighter. Speaks clearly but not defensively. A small smile—she means every word. Slight pause before 'grateful' to let it land.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 校歌の、本気で、絶対、斉唱、絶対、歴史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And your analysis of the school anthem's historical context—the breadth of your perspective was really remarkable. You should be proud of that work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reflective. Voice softens on 'remarkable.' Not gushing—steady and genuine. Pauses briefly to let her absorb the praise. A teacher speaking to a student who's earned it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。古代の、本気で、絶対、流星、絶対、観測、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I researched the historical observations of ancient astronomical phenomena very carefully. I'm really grateful for your feedback.
lines.style: Composed, sincere nod in her voice. Not performing gratitude—actually receiving it. Slight warmth in tone. Speaks at an even pace, grounded.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 武家階級が、本気で、絶対、昇る、絶対、過程、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you traced the samurai class's rise through institutional structures—that was thoughtfully done. I could see the care in your research.
lines.style: Engaging but not effusive. Voice carries approval without overdoing it. Settles into the rhythm of the conversation. A slight lift at 'structures' showing genuine interest in her methodology.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。アイドル文化の、本気で、絶対、追っかけ、絶対、現象、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I examined idol culture fan dynamics as a social phenomenon with a lot of depth. I appreciate your recognition of that work.
lines.style: Quiet confidence underlying the gratitude. Speaks with the composure of someone who knows what she did well but isn't arrogant about it. Steady breath, measured delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: メディアの、本気で、絶対、エコー、絶対、チェンバー現象、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your paper on media echo chambers and how they function—that showed real analytical maturity. I was genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Reflective and measured. Slight emphasis on 'analytical maturity'—this is substantive praise. Voice stays warm but thoughtful. A teacher recognizing intellectual growth, not just effort.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。文学の、本気で、絶対、ライティング、絶対、技法、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I worked very carefully on the literary writing techniques throughout the paper. I'm truly grateful for your support.
lines.style: Final response carries quiet satisfaction. Soft but clear. A gentle close—no defensiveness, just genuine thanks. Voice settles slightly, like a natural ending point in the conversation.
